  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND t.Amount IS NOT NULL AND t.Price IS NOT NULL

  SELECT ProductID, TransactionID, Amount, p,

  FROM sm

           COUNT(*) AS cost,
           SUM(tr.Amount) AS value
    FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr
    JOIN birdbench.products p ON tr.ProductID = p.ProductID
    JOIN birdbench.customers c ON tr.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND tr.Amount > 0
      AND tr.ProductID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY tr.ProductID
),
cand AS (
    SELECT ProductID, cost, value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ProductID) - 1 AS pos
    FROM eligible
    ORDER BY ProductID
    LIMIT 8
),
bud AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(FLOOR(SUM(cost) / 3), 0) AS budget
    FROM cand
),
d AS (
    SELECT 0 AS d UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7
),
nums AS (
    SELECT a.d + 8 * b.d + 64 * c.d AS n
    FROM d a CROSS JOIN d b CROSS JOIN d c
    WHERE a.d + 8 * b.d + 64 * c.d <= 255
),
subsets AS (
    SELECT nums.n AS mask,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (nums.n >> cand.pos) & 1 THEN cand.cost END), 0) AS cost,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (nums.n >> cand.pos) & 1 THEN cand.value END), 0) AS value,
           RPAD(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN (nums.n >> cand.pos) & 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END ORDER BY cand.pos SEPARATOR ''), 8, '0') AS subset_key,
           COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN (nums.n >> cand.pos) & 1 THEN cand.ProductID END ORDER BY cand.ProductID SEPARATOR ','), '') AS chosen_products
    FROM nums CROSS JOIN cand
    GROUP BY nums.n
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT b.budget AS budget,
           s.subset_key AS subset_key,
           s.chosen_products AS chosen_products,
           s.cost AS total_cost,
           s.value AS total_value
    FROM bud b CROSS JOIN subsets s
    WHERE s.cost <= b.budget
)
SELECT budget, subset_key, chosen_products, total_cost, total_value
FROM ranked
UNION ALL

WITH RECURSIVE
nums AS (
  SELECT 0 AS n
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n + 1 FROM nums WHERE n < 24
),
fact AS (
  SELECT 0 AS n, CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(38,0)) AS f
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n + 1, f * (n + 1) FROM fact WHERE n < 24
),
binom AS (
  SELECT fa.n AS n, fb.n AS k, ROUND(fa.f / (fb.f * fc.f), 0) AS c
  FROM fact fa
  JOIN fact fb ON fb.n <= fa.n
  JOIN fact fc ON fc.n = fa.n - fb.n
),
t AS (
  SELECT tr.TransactionID, tr.ProductID, tr.Amount,
         CAST(tr.Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p
  FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr
  JOIN birdbench.customers c ON tr.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  JOIN birdbench.products pr ON tr.ProductID = pr.ProductID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND tr.Amount IS NOT NULL
    AND tr.Price IS NOT NULL
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT ProductID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM t
  GROUP BY ProductID
),
rk AS (
  SELECT ProductID, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC, ProductID ASC) AS rn
  FROM cnt
  WHERE cnt >= 6
),
sel AS (
  SELECT ProductID FROM rk WHERE rn <= 8
),
smp AS (
  SELECT t.ProductID, t.TransactionID, t.Amount, t.p,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.ProductID ORDER BY t.TransactionID) AS rn
  FROM t
  JOIN sel ON t.ProductID = sel.ProductID
),
s24 AS (
  SELECT ProductID, TransactionID, Amount, p
  FROM smp
  WHERE rn <= 24
),
rnk AS (
  SELECT ProductID, TransactionID, Amount, p,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ProductID ORDER BY Amount, TransactionID) AS ra,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ProductID) AS n
  FROM s24
),
med AS (
  SELECT ProductID,
         MAX(n) AS n,
         AVG(CAST(Amount AS DECIMAL(60,18))) AS median_amount,
         AVG(CAST(p AS DECIMAL(60,18))) AS median_price
  FROM rnk
  WHERE ra IN (FLOOR((n + 1) / 2), FLOOR((n + 2) / 2))
  GROUP BY ProductID
),
flg AS (
  SELECT s.ProductID,
         CASE WHEN s.Amount > m.median_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ha,
         CASE WHEN s.p > m.median_price THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hp
  FROM s24 s
  JOIN med m ON s.ProductID = m.ProductID
),
st AS (
  SELECT ProductID,
         COUNT(*) AS sample_rows,
         SUM(ha) AS R,
         SUM(hp) AS K,
         SUM(ha * hp) AS A
  FROM flg
  GROUP BY ProductID
),
terms AS (
  SELECT st.ProductID, st.sample_rows AS N, st.R, st.K, st.A,
         nums.n AS x,
         b1.c AS c1, b2.c AS c2, b3.c AS denom
  FROM st
  JOIN nums
    ON nums.n BETWEEN GREATEST(st.A, GREATEST(0, st.R + st.K - st.sample_rows))
                  AND LEAST(st.R, st.K)
  JOIN binom b1 ON b1.n = st.K AND b1.k = nums.n
  JOIN binom b2 ON b2.n = st.sample_rows - st.K AND b2.k = st.R - nums.n
  JOIN binom b3 ON b3.n = st.sample_rows AND b3.k = st.R
)
SELECT ProductID AS product_id,
       MAX(N) AS sample_rows,
       MAX(R) AS high_amount_rows,
       MAX(K) AS high_price_rows,
       MAX(A) AS both_high_rows,
       ROUND(CAST(SUM(c1 * c2) AS DECIMAL(60,18)) / MAX(denom), 6) AS upper_tail
FROM terms
GROUP BY ProductID
ORDER BY ProductID

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT tr.ProductID, COUNT(*) AS cost, SUM(tr.Amount) AS value
  FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr
  JOIN birdbench.customers c ON tr.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  JOIN birdbench.products p ON tr.ProductID = p.ProductID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND tr.Amount > 0
  GROUP BY tr.ProductID
),
cand AS (
  SELECT e.ProductID, e.cost, e.value,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible e2 WHERE e2.ProductID < e.ProductID) AS pos
  FROM eligible e
  ORDER BY e.ProductID
  LIMIT 8
),
digits AS (
  SELECT 0 AS d UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3
  UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7
),
nums AS (
  SELECT a.d + 8*b.d + 64*c.d AS s
  FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b CROSS JOIN digits c
  WHERE c.d < 4 AND a.d + 8*b.d + 64*c.d < POW(2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cand))
),
subsets AS (
  SELECT n.s,
         COALESCE(SUM(cc.cost), 0) AS total_cost,
         COALESCE(SUM(cc.value), 0) AS total_value,
         COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(cc.ProductID ORDER BY cc.ProductID SEPARATOR ','), '') AS chosen_products
  FROM nums n
  LEFT JOIN cand cc ON (n.s & (1 << cc.pos)) <> 0
  GROUP BY n.s
),
bud AS (
  SELECT FLOOR(COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) / 3) AS budget FROM cand
)
SELECT bud.budget AS budget,
       REVERSE(LPAD(BIN(subsets.s), 8, '0')) AS subset_key,
       subsets.chosen_products AS chosen_products,
       subsets.total_cost AS total_cost,
       subsets.total_value AS total_value
FROM subsets CROSS JOIN bud
WHERE subsets.total_cost <= bud.budget
ORDER BY total_value DESC, total_cost ASC, subset_key ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH norm AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, Date, CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS cons
  FROM birdbench.yearmonth
  WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
    AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999'
    AND Consumption IS NOT NULL
),
panels AS (
  SELECT CustomerID
  FROM norm
  WHERE Date IN ('201303','201304','201305','201306')
  GROUP BY CustomerID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Date) = 4
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM birdbench.transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Currency
  FROM birdbench.customers c
  JOIN panels p ON c.CustomerID = p.CustomerID
  JOIN active a ON c.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency IN ('CZK','EUR')
),
lefts AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CustomerID) AS rn
  FROM eligible WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
  ORDER BY CustomerID
  LIMIT 3
),
rights AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CustomerID) AS rn
  FROM eligible WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
  ORDER BY CustomerID
  LIMIT 4
),
lc AS (
  SELECT l.CustomerID, n.Date, n.cons
  FROM lefts l JOIN norm n ON l.CustomerID = n.CustomerID
  WHERE n.Date IN ('201303','201304','201305','201306')
),
rc AS (
  SELECT r.CustomerID, n.Date, n.cons
  FROM rights r JOIN norm n ON r.CustomerID = n.CustomerID
  WHERE n.Date IN ('201303','201304','201305','201306')
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT l.CustomerID AS left_customer_id, l.rn AS lrn,
         r.CustomerID AS right_customer_id, r.rn AS rrn,
         SUM(ABS(lc.cons - rc.cons)) AS pair_cost
  FROM lefts l
  CROSS JOIN rights r
  JOIN lc ON lc.CustomerID = l.CustomerID
  JOIN rc ON rc.CustomerID = r.CustomerID AND rc.Date = lc.Date
  GROUP BY l.CustomerID, l.rn, r.CustomerID, r.rn
),
best AS (
  SELECT p1.left_customer_id AS l1, p1.right_customer_id AS r1, p1.pair_cost AS c1,
         p2.left_customer_id AS l2, p2.right_customer_id AS r2, p2.pair_cost AS c2,
         p3.left_customer_id AS l3, p3.right_customer_id AS r3, p3.pair_cost AS c3,
         p1.pair_cost + p2.pair_cost + p3.pair_cost AS total
  FROM pairs p1
  JOIN pairs p2 ON p2.lrn = 2 AND p2.rrn <> p1.rrn
  JOIN pairs p3 ON p3.lrn = 3 AND p3.rrn NOT IN (p1.rrn, p2.rrn)
  WHERE p1.lrn = 1
  ORDER BY total, r1, r2, r3
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT l1 AS left_customer_id, r1 AS right_customer_id, ROUND(c1,6) AS pair_cost, ROUND(total,6) AS assignment_total_cost
FROM best
UNION ALL
SELECT l2, r2, ROUND(c2,6), ROUND(total,6) FROM best
UNION ALL
SELECT l3, r3, ROUND(c3,6), ROUND(total,6) FROM best
ORDER BY left_customer_id

  JOIN pairs p3 ON p3.left_rn = 3 AND p3.right_rn NOT IN (p1.right_rn, p2.right_rn)

       COALESCE(SUM(CAST(b.cprice AS DECIMAL(38,6))), 0) sum_attached_price
FROM probes pr
LEFT JOIN best b ON b.pid = pr.ProductID AND b.ptid = pr.TransactionID
GROUP BY pr.ProductID
ORDER BY pr.ProductID

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT t.ProductID, t.TransactionID, t.Amount,
         CAST(t.Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS price
  FROM birdbench.transactions_1k t
  JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  JOIN birdbench.products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND t.Amount IS NOT NULL
    AND t.Price IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT ProductID, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC, ProductID ASC) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT ProductID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM eligible
    GROUP BY ProductID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6
  ) c
),
selected AS (
  SELECT ProductID FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 8
),
samp AS (
  SELECT e.ProductID, e.TransactionID, e.Amount, e.price,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ProductID ORDER BY e.TransactionID) AS rn
  FROM eligible e
  JOIN selected s ON e.ProductID = s.ProductID
),
snap AS (
  SELECT ProductID, TransactionID, Amount, price
  FROM samp
  WHERE rn <= 24
),
sn AS (
  SELECT ProductID, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM snap
  GROUP BY ProductID
),
amt_r AS (
  SELECT ProductID, Amount, TransactionID,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ProductID ORDER BY Amount, TransactionID) AS rn
  FROM snap
),
med_amount AS (
  SELECT a.ProductID, AVG(CAST(a.Amount AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS med
  FROM amt_r a
  JOIN sn ON a.ProductID = sn.ProductID
  WHERE a.rn IN (FLOOR((sn.n + 1) / 2), FLOOR((sn.n + 2) / 2))
  GROUP BY a.ProductID
),
prc_r AS (
  SELECT ProductID, price, TransactionID,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ProductID ORDER BY price, TransactionID) AS rn
  FROM snap
),
med_price AS (
  SELECT a.ProductID, AVG(a.price) AS med
  FROM prc_r a
  JOIN sn ON a.ProductID = sn.ProductID
  WHERE a.rn IN (FLOOR((sn.n + 1) / 2), FLOOR((sn.n + 2) / 2))
  GROUP BY a.ProductID
),
flags AS (
  SELECT s.ProductID,
         CASE WHEN s.Amount > ma.med THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ha,
         CASE WHEN s.price > mp.med THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hp
  FROM snap s
  JOIN med_amount ma ON s.ProductID = ma.ProductID
  JOIN med_price mp ON s.ProductID = mp.ProductID
),
margins AS (
  SELECT ProductID,
         COUNT(*) AS N,
         SUM(ha) AS R,
         SUM(hp) AS K,
         SUM(ha * hp) AS A
  FROM flags
  GROUP BY ProductID
),
nums AS (
  SELECT d1.n * 10 + d2.n AS n
  FROM (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2) d1
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3
              UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7
              UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) d2
  WHERE d1.n * 10 + d2.n <= 24
),
fl AS (
  SELECT a.n AS n, COALESCE(SUM(LN(b.n)), 0) AS lnf
  FROM nums a
  LEFT JOIN nums b ON b.n >= 1 AND b.n <= a.n
  GROUP BY a.n
),
tail AS (
  SELECT m.ProductID,
         EXP((f1.lnf - f2.lnf - f3.lnf)
           + (f4.lnf - f5.lnf - f6.lnf)
           - (f7.lnf - f8.lnf - f9.lnf)) AS w
  FROM margins m
  JOIN nums x ON x.n >= m.A
             AND x.n <= LEAST(m.R, m.K)
             AND x.n >= GREATEST(0, m.R + m.K - m.N)
  JOIN fl f1 ON f1.n = m.K
  JOIN fl f2 ON f2.n = x.n
  JOIN fl f3 ON f3.n = m.K - x.n
  JOIN fl f4 ON f4.n = m.N - m.K
  JOIN fl f5 ON f5.n = m.R - x.n
  JOIN fl f6 ON f6.n = m.N - m.K - (m.R - x.n)
  JOIN fl f7 ON f7.n = m.N
  JOIN fl f8 ON f8.n = m.R
  JOIN fl f9 ON f9.n = m.N - m.R
)
SELECT m.ProductID AS product_id,
       m.N AS sample_rows,
       m.R AS high_amount_rows,
       m.K AS high_price_rows,
       m.A AS both_high_rows,
       ROUND(SUM(t.w), 6) AS upper_tail
FROM margins m
JOIN tail t ON m.ProductID = t.ProductID
GROUP BY m.ProductID, m.N, m.R, m.K, m.A
ORDER BY m.ProductID

WITH cands AS (
  SELECT t.ProductID,
         COUNT(*) AS cost,
         SUM(t.Amount) AS value
  FROM transactions_1k t
  JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
  JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND t.Amount > 0
  GROUP BY t.ProductID
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT ProductID, cost, value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ProductID) - 1 AS pos
  FROM cands
  ORDER BY ProductID
  LIMIT 8
),
budget AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost) DIV 3, 0) AS b FROM ordered
),
masks AS (
  SELECT d0.n + 2*d1.n + 4*d2.n + 8*d3.n + 16*d4.n + 32*d5.n + 64*d6.n + 128*d7.n AS mask
  FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1) d0
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1) d1
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1) d2
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1) d3
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1) d4
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1) d5
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1) d6
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1) d7
),
subsets AS (
  SELECT s.mask,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (s.mask >> o.pos) & 1 = 1 THEN o.cost ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_cost,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (s.mask >> o.pos) & 1 = 1 THEN o.value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_value,
         GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN (s.mask >> o.pos) & 1 = 1 THEN o.ProductID END ORDER BY o.pos SEPARATOR ',') AS chosen_products
  FROM masks s
  LEFT JOIN ordered o ON 1 = 1
  GROUP BY s.mask
)
SELECT b.b AS budget,
       LPAD(CONV(s.mask, 10, 2), 8, '0') AS subset_key,
       COALESCE(s.chosen_products, '') AS chosen_products,
       s.total_cost AS total_cost,
       s.total_value AS total_value
FROM subsets s
CROSS JOIN budget b
WHERE s.total_cost <= b.b
ORDER BY s.total_value DESC, s.total_cost ASC, subset_key ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH panel AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, Date, CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS consumption
  FROM birdbench.yearmonth
  WHERE Date IN ('201303','201304','201305','201306')
    AND Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
    AND Consumption IS NOT NULL
),
complete AS (
  SELECT CustomerID
  FROM panel
  GROUP BY CustomerID
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 4 AND MIN(Date) = '201303' AND MAX(Date) = '201306'
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
  FROM birdbench.transactions_1k
  WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Currency
  FROM birdbench.customers c
  JOIN complete p ON c.CustomerID = p.CustomerID
  JOIN active a ON c.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency IN ('CZK','EUR')
),
left_cust AS (
  SELECT CustomerID FROM eligible WHERE Currency = 'CZK' ORDER BY CustomerID LIMIT 3
),
right_cand AS (
  SELECT CustomerID FROM eligible WHERE Currency = 'EUR' ORDER BY CustomerID LIMIT 4
),
ok AS (
  SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM left_cust) AS n_left,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM right_cand) AS n_right
),
left_ranked AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CustomerID) AS rn FROM left_cust
),
right_ranked AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CustomerID) AS rn FROM right_cand
),
costs AS (
  SELECT l.rn AS lrn, r.rn AS rrn, l.CustomerID AS left_id, r.CustomerID AS right_id,
         SUM(ABS(lp.consumption - rp.consumption)) AS pair_cost
  FROM left_ranked l
  JOIN right_ranked r
  JOIN panel lp ON lp.CustomerID = l.CustomerID
  JOIN panel rp ON rp.CustomerID = r.CustomerID AND rp.Date = lp.Date
  GROUP BY l.rn, r.rn, l.CustomerID, r.CustomerID
),
assignments AS (
  SELECT m1.rrn AS r1, m2.rrn AS r2, m3.rrn AS r3,
         m1.pair_cost + m2.pair_cost + m3.pair_cost AS total
  FROM costs m1
  JOIN costs m2 ON m2.lrn = 2 AND m2.rrn <> m1.rrn
  JOIN costs m3 ON m3.lrn = 3 AND m3.rrn <> m1.rrn AND m3.rrn <> m2.rrn
  WHERE m1.lrn = 1
),
best AS (
  SELECT total, r1, r2, r3
  FROM assignments
  ORDER BY total ASC, r1 ASC, r2 ASC, r3 ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
mapped AS (
  SELECT l.rn AS lrn, l.CustomerID AS left_id,
         CASE l.rn WHEN 1 THEN b.r1 WHEN 2 THEN b.r2 ELSE b.r3 END AS assigned_rrn,
         b.total
  FROM left_ranked l
  CROSS JOIN best b
)
SELECT m.left_id AS left_customer_id,
       rr.CustomerID AS right_customer_id,
       ROUND(c.pair_cost, 6) AS pair_cost,
       ROUND(m.total, 6) AS assignment_total_cost
FROM mapped m
JOIN right_ranked rr ON rr.rn = m.assigned_rrn
JOIN costs c ON c.lrn = m.lrn AND c.rrn = m.assigned_rrn
CROSS JOIN ok
WHERE ok.n_left = 3 AND ok.n_right >= 3
ORDER BY m.left_id

WITH t AS (
  SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
  CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$' THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts
  FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr
),
m AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
  CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v
  FROM birdbench.yearmonth
  WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999'
),
panel AS (
  SELECT CustomerID
  FROM m
  WHERE ym >= '201303' AND ym <= '201306'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 4 AND COUNT(v) = 4
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM t WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
lefts AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.CustomerID) rn
  FROM birdbench.customers c
  JOIN panel p ON c.CustomerID = p.CustomerID
  JOIN active a ON c.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
  ORDER BY c.CustomerID
  LIMIT 3
),
rights AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.CustomerID) rn
  FROM birdbench.customers c
  JOIN panel p ON c.CustomerID = p.CustomerID
  JOIN active a ON c.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  ORDER BY c.CustomerID
  LIMIT 4
),
lc AS (
  SELECT l.CustomerID, l.rn, m.ym, CAST(m.v AS DECIMAL(60,18)) v
  FROM lefts l JOIN m ON l.CustomerID = m.CustomerID
  WHERE m.ym >= '201303' AND m.ym <= '201306'
),
rc AS (
  SELECT r.CustomerID, r.rn, m.ym, CAST(m.v AS DECIMAL(60,18)) v
  FROM rights r JOIN m ON r.CustomerID = m.CustomerID
  WHERE m.ym >= '201303' AND m.ym <= '201306'
),
costs AS (
  SELECT l.CustomerID left_id, r.CustomerID right_id, l.rn lrn, r.rn rrn,
         SUM(ABS(l.v - r.v)) c
  FROM lc l JOIN rc r ON l.ym = r.ym
  GROUP BY l.CustomerID, r.CustomerID, l.rn, r.rn
),
assigned AS (
  SELECT a1.left_id l1, a1.right_id r1, a1.c c1,
         a2.left_id l2, a2.right_id r2, a2.c c2,
         a3.left_id l3, a3.right_id r3, a3.c c3
  FROM costs a1
  JOIN costs a2 ON a1.lrn = 1 AND a2.lrn = 2 AND a2.rrn <> a1.rrn
  JOIN costs a3 ON a3.lrn = 3 AND a3.rrn <> a1.rrn AND a3.rrn <> a2.rrn
),
obj AS (
  SELECT l1, r1, c1, l2, r2, c2, l3, r3, c3,
         GREATEST(c1, c2, c3) maxc,
         c1 + c2 + c3 totc
  FROM assigned
),
best AS (
  SELECT * FROM obj
  ORDER BY maxc, totc, r1, r2, r3
  LIMIT 1
),
final AS (
  SELECT l1 left_id, r1 right_id, c1 c, maxc, totc FROM best
  UNION ALL SELECT l2, r2, c2, maxc, totc FROM best
  UNION ALL SELECT l3, r3, c3, maxc, totc FROM best
)
SELECT left_id left_customer_id, right_id right_customer_id,
       ROUND(c, 6) pair_cost,
       ROUND(maxc, 6) assignment_max_cost,
       ROUND(totc, 6) assignment_total_cost
FROM final
ORDER BY left_id

WITH months AS (
  SELECT '201304' AS ym
  UNION ALL SELECT '201305'
  UNION ALL SELECT '201306'
  UNION ALL SELECT '201307'
  UNION ALL SELECT '201308'
  UNION ALL SELECT '201309'
  UNION ALL SELECT '201310'
  UNION ALL SELECT '201311'
),
panels AS (
  SELECT ym.CustomerID
  FROM birdbench.yearmonth ym
  JOIN months m ON ym.Date = m.ym
  WHERE ym.Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
    AND ym.Consumption IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ym.Date) = 8
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID
  FROM birdbench.transactions_1k t
  JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE t.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT p.CustomerID
  FROM panels p
  JOIN active a ON p.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
  ORDER BY p.CustomerID
  LIMIT 8
),
data AS (
  SELECT ym.CustomerID, ym.Date,
         CAST(ym.Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS c
  FROM birdbench.yearmonth ym
  JOIN eligible e ON ym.CustomerID = e.CustomerID
  WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201304' AND '201311'
    AND ym.Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
    AND ym.Consumption IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, Date, c,
         CAST(SUM(c) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY Date ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS DECIMAL(60,18)) / 3 AS f
  FROM data
),
errors AS (
  SELECT CustomerID,
         c - f AS err
  FROM scored
  WHERE Date >= '201307'
)
SELECT CustomerID AS customer_id,
       5 AS scored_months,
       ROUND(AVG(err * err), 6) AS mean_squared_error,
       ROUND(AVG(ABS(err)), 6) AS mean_absolute_error
FROM errors
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY CustomerID;
